audit_items.proof_trace: The Discord guild membership check (fetchMemberStatus call) is explicitly commented out at L105-119 of the auth callback, allowing any Discord OAuth user with a valid member.members DB record to establish a Supabase session without server membership verification. The compensating control in dashboard/layout.tsx (L129-133) is fail-open: the guard condition `discordCheck.success && !discordCheck.isInServer` evaluates to false when the STEM Bot API returns a non-2xx HTTP response (success: false), silently granting dashboard access to expelled users during any API degradation. The checkDiscordMembership function (actions.ts:L1256-1258) returns {success: false} for non-ok responses rather than throwing, bypassing the catch block's redirect.
audit_items.attack_scenario: A user who has been removed from the Discord server but retains a member.members DB record completes the Discord OAuth PKCE flow, exchanges the authorization code at /auth/callback to obtain a valid Supabase session, then accesses /dashboard during any period when the STEM Bot API returns a non-2xx HTTP status — causing checkDiscordMembership to return {success: false, isInServer: false}, bypassing the layout-level guild check and granting full dashboard access.
